title: Release orchestration stitchboard & daybook (June 2026) - WIP
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight but operationally actionable stitchboard and daybook for the June 2026 release window. Serves as the combined checklist, short rollout calendar, and living release notes for the launch team. Keep concise — link out for long runbooks.

Scope:
- Services in scope: control-plane, serving-runtime, batching-proxy
- Rollout type: regional staggered canary with progressive traffic increases and safety gates
- Target release window: Fri 2026-06-25 -> Mon 2026-06-28 (primary ops window: 22:00–04:00 UTC each day)

TL;DR (for on-call):
- 22:00 UTC Fri: start canary in us-west-2 with 1% traffic
- 23:30 UTC: increase to 5% if telemetry green
- 01:30 UTC: 20% if no regressions
- 03:30 UTC: 50% then overnight hold
- Next day: resume ramp to 100% across regions (per calendar below)
- Rollback trigger: sustained error rate >1.0% for 10m OR 25% increase in median latency vs baseline OR accuracy/regression alerts from quality checks

Day-by-day mini-calendar (local times included):
- Fri 2026-06-25 22:00 UTC (15:00 PDT): Canary start - us-west-2 (1%)
- Fri 2026-06-25 23:30 UTC (16:30 PDT): Canary ramp to 5%
- Sat 2026-06-26 01:30 UTC (18:30 PDT Fri): Ramp to 20% if gates pass
- Sat 2026-06-26 03:30 UTC (20:30 PDT Fri): Ramp to 50% then hold overnight
- Sat 2026-06-26 15:00 UTC (08:00 PDT): Resume - expand to eu-west-1 at 2%
- Sun 2026-06-27 00:00 UTC: Global ramping schedule continues per region list in section below

Canary sequencing notes:
- Sequence order: us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 -> ap-southeast-1 (if capacity available)
- Each region has an 8hr observation window before final ramp in that region
- Routing: sticky sessions preserved; small percentage of users will see new variant, use cookie prefixing for tracing

Preflight checklist (must pass before 22:00 UTC):
- [ ] All GH PRs merged and green (PRs: linked_artifacts PR list)
- [ ] Smoke tests passing on staging (smoke job id = CI-SMOKE-142)
- [ ] KPIs snapshot taken (latency/avail/error baseline) and stored in S3: s3://release-artifacts/2026-06-25/kpi-snapshot.json
- [ ] DB migrations reviewed & dryruned; migration window approved if needed
- [ ] Pager rotations set for release channel and on-call names posted in #release-day
- [ ] Canary circuit breakers configured in routing policy (max 50% traffic cap)

Night-of quick runbook (ops play-by-play):
- T-60: Standup in #release-ops (15m) - confirm owners and roll authority
- T-30: Lock down CI and tag artifacts (release:v2026.6.25)
- T-0: Kickoff deploy (relayer deploy job) and validate PODs come up healthy
- +10m: Verify health endpoints, kv-cache hitrates, worker queue depth
- +30m: Check telemetry gates (see thresholds) -> if failed, immediately reduce traffic to 0% and escalate

Telemetry gates (explicit thresholds):
- Error rate (4xx/5xx): must remain <= 0.5% (warning) and <=1.0% (fail) over a 10m sliding window
- Median p50 latency (inference path): no more than +20% vs baseline average over 30m
- P95 latency: no more than +40% vs baseline over 30m
- Quality: top-10 prompt regression alerts = 0 (if any >0, pause rollout and run regression set)
- Resource: GPU mem pressure avg < 70% across serving pool; queue length < 500 messages

Rollback matrix (quick):
- Soft rollback: reduce traffic to previous stable variant (if AB) and open mitigations ticket
- Full rollback: redeploy previous artifact tag to all regions and schedule immediate postmortem
- If rollback executed, run isolation plan: disable model variants that changed, flush caches, re-evaluate KV cache effects

Communications & Escalation:
- Primary comms: Slack #release-day (ops channel) and #oncall (for escalations)
- Incident bridge: +1 415-555-0101 / Zoom link pinned in #release-day
- Escalation order: release lead (Maya H) -> SRE lead (Arjun P) -> Eng manager (Lena W)

Post-release notes (templates for final doc):
- Release summary: short bulleted list of what shipped
- Observed anomalies: list, with timestamps and mitigation steps taken
- Telemetry comparison: baseline vs post-release snapshot (links to metrics)
- Follow-ups: owners and due dates for fallout items

Open questions / TODOs (live):
- (TODO) Confirm APAC capacity window with infra (Diego) by 2026-06-18
- (Question) Should we enable pre-warm pools for serving-runtime for us-east-1? Pros/cons in comments
- (Action) Add regression prompt set to CI as smoke check (Priya owning, due 2026-06-20)

Notes to self: keep this doc lightweight. Move final release notes into confluence after day-of wrap. If any manual rollback required, do not self-assign postmortem — open a task and ping SRE lead.

Revision history: 2026-06-10 initial draft by Maya H; 2026-06-14 added telemetry thresholds (Arjun P); 2026-06-18 calendar tweaks and collaborators added.
